# Serialization Graph Construction

## 1. History Instantiation

The history fixes per-transaction order only, so I instantiate the canonical concurrent interleaving (same as the conflict analysis), then show the verdict is interleaving-invariant:

```
R2(A)₀, R2(B)₀, R1(A)₀, W1(A)₁, R1(B)₀, W1(B)₁, C1,
W2(A)₂, W2(B)₂, C2, R3(A)₂, R3(B)₂, C3
```

Derived structures (MVCC formalization):

| Structure | Value |
|---|---|
| Version order A | A₀ < A₁(T1) < A₂(T2) |
| Version order B | B₀ < B₁(T1) < B₂(T2) |
| Reads-from | RF1 = {A₀, B₀}, RF2 = {A₀, B₀}, RF3 = {A₂, B₂} |

## 2. Graph: SG = (V, E)

**Nodes:** V = {T0, T1, T2, T3} — T0 is the initial-version source (no reads of it as data; it only emits wr edges).

**Edges (10):**

| # | Edge | Label | Justification |
|---|---|---|---|
| E1 | T0 → T1 | wr(A) | R1(A) reads A₀ |
| E2 | T0 → T1 | wr(B) | R1(B) reads B₀ |
| E3 | T0 → T2 | wr(A) | R2(A) reads A₀ |
| E4 | T0 → T2 | wr(B) | R2(B) reads B₀ |
| E5 | T1 → T2 | ww(A) | A₁ < A₂ in version order |
| E6 | T1 → T2
